title: WebSocket vs SSE: realtime comparison
text: WebSocket keeps a single TCP connection open for two-way messaging while SSE streams server-to-client over plain HTTP. WebSocket suits chat and multiplayer games where the client must also send. SSE suits feeds, price ticks and notifications because it is simpler and reconnects automatically.

title: Adding an index to a Postgres table
text: Postgres scans the whole table when no index exists on the filter column. Run CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email); to fix slow queries. Verify the plan with EXPLAIN before and after; the planner should switch from Seq Scan to Index Scan.

title: Karpathy on ASD-STE100 prompting
text: Karpathy suggested asking the LLM to explain answers in ASD-STE100, about 80% of the way. The aerospace standard forces short sentences and one meaning per word. He also recommends diagrams, HTML pages and explainer videos as stronger formats than plain text.

title: The llms.txt proposal
text: llms.txt is a markdown file at the site root that lists what the site offers and links its key pages. Version 2 shipped in August 2026. Agents fetch it first so they do not crawl blindly. It is a proposal, not an official web standard.

title: Rust borrow checker explained
text: The borrow checker enforces ownership rules at compile time. Every value has one owner and borrows are either shared or exclusive. This prevents data races without a garbage collector. New Rust users hit it most with self-referential structs.

title: JavaScript event loop basics
text: The event loop takes callbacks from task queues after the call stack empties. Microtasks such as promise callbacks run before the next macrotask. Blocking the loop with sync IO freezes rendering. Use async and await to keep the loop free.

title: Istanbulkart fares and top-up
text: Istanbulkart is the prepaid travel card for buses, metro, tram and ferries in Istanbul. Top up at yellow machines at stations or the mobile app. Discounted transfers apply within a time window after the first tap.

title: Turkish coffee brewing
text: Turkish coffee uses very fine grounds simmered in a cezve with cold water and sugar. Serve unfILTERed in small cups with foam on top. Never boil hard; foam carries the aroma.
